beaches.name: Smiltynė nudist beach
beaches.summary: A 200 m nudist beach is designated on Smiltynė's Old Ferry beaches. The 2025 plan of BĮ Klaipėdos paplūdimiai, Klaipėda city's municipal beach operator, places it next to the 300 m men's beach, with the 1200 m general beach beyond; the other sections are general, men's, women's and dog-walking use. The plan shows the nudist section outside the lifeguard-supervised area.

beaches.name: Giruliai nudist beach
beaches.summary: Two marked 200 m nudist zones sit at the northern end of Giruliai beach. Klaipėda's municipal beach operator's 2025 plan separates them with a 50 m no-swimming gap at a boat slipway; the beaches south of them are general use.
